title: Conversation Memory under a Token Budget
signature: def build_context(messages, budget, keep_last, reserve, summarize)
hints: First group messages into units: an assistant turn with tool_calls plus the tool messages right after it is one unit, and anything else is a unit of one.
Pin the system prompt and the last keep_last units. Start the running total from message_tokens of those.
Walk the older units from newest to oldest and stop at the first one that would push the total past budget - reserve. Don't skip it and keep going.
Whatever is left, a contiguous prefix of the history, goes to summarize() once, in original order. If nothing is left, don't call it.
